seller_or_subject: Chopeo Medium — Competitor platform groups Kichink alongside itself as commission-based model vs Shopify's subscription model
what: Chopeo (a competing ecommerce platform) groups Kichink and Chopeo together as commission-based platforms, contrasting them with Shopify's monthly subscription starting at $200 MXN.
verbatim_snippet: "Empresas como Shopify cobran una cuota mensual desde $200 pesos al mes (y la puedes cancelar en cualquier momento). Otras como Kichink o Chopeo tienen un modelo de comisión por transacción, lo que significa que solo te cuesta cuando vendes."
notes: Text confirmed in Google search result snippet from my search. Author is Chopeo, a competing ecommerce platform — disclosed affiliation (Chopeo is writing about its own market segment). Competitors named: Shopify, Kichink. Kichink is named but not the focus of the article. Comparison dimension: pricing model.
